conventions.rest_pose: A-pose (arms 20 deg out), identity rest rotations; pose = local quaternion (x,y,z,w) relative to rest
conventions.euler: intrinsic XYZ degrees; positive X swings a downward-pointing limb backward (knee flexion x in [0,150], elbow flexion x in [-145,0], hip flexion negative); positive Z swings a downward limb toward +x (left abduction +z)
conventions.limits: per-bone ranges relative to rest for the G6 joint-limit gate; null = fixed or not limited; the _R bone has the y/z ranges mirrored
conventions.tier: plausible-procedural (rig layout and limit ranges are authored for this project; the limit magnitudes are common anatomical ranges quoted from memory, not from a source read in this task: TIERS.json F-RIG-LIMITS)
